steps.title: What the bundle wrote
steps.text: The line **Hello Webpack** under the summary is not in the HTML file. `bundle.js` makes that `<div>` when it runs: `src/index.js` joins two words with Lodash's `_.join` and adds the result to the page.
steps.textZh: 摘要下面那行 **Hello Webpack** 并不在 HTML 文件里。它是 `bundle.js` 运行时生成的 `<div>`：`src/index.js` 用 Lodash 的 `_.join` 把两个词连起来，再把结果加到页面上。

steps.title: One script tag, written for you
steps.titleZh: 一个 script 标签，由插件写好
steps.text: HtmlWebpackPlugin wrote `dist/index.html` with a `<script>` tag for `bundle.js`. It put the tag in `<head>` with `defer`, which makes the browser run the script only after it has read the whole page. That is why the `<div>` appears after the heading.
steps.textZh: HtmlWebpackPlugin 生成 `dist/index.html` 时，写进了一个引用 `bundle.js` 的 `<script>` 标签。它把标签放在 `<head>` 里并加上 `defer`，浏览器会等读完整个页面才运行这段脚本。所以 `<div>` 出现在标题之后。

watch.label: Page scripts (not counting the guide)
watch.labelZh: 页面脚本（不含说明面板）

steps.title: Lodash travelled inside bundle.js
steps.text: The page loads no separate Lodash file. webpack started at the entry, `src/index.js`, the first file it reads, followed its `import` to `lodash` and wrote both into one minified file. The minifier moved Lodash's license comment into `bundle.js.LICENSE.txt`, and the first line of `bundle.js` points to it. This step fetches both files.
steps.textZh: 页面没有单独加载 Lodash 文件。webpack 从入口（entry）`src/index.js` 开始，也就是它读的第一个文件，顺着其中的 `import` 找到 `lodash`，再把两者写进同一个压缩后的文件。压缩工具把 Lodash 的许可注释挪进了 `bundle.js.LICENSE.txt`，`bundle.js` 的第一行就指向这个文件。这一步会获取这两个文件。

action.run: Promise.all(['bundle.js', 'bundle.js.LICENSE.txt'].map((f) => fetch(f).then((r) => r.text()))).then(([bundle, license]) => { console.log('bundle.js, line 1:', bundle.split('\n')[0]); console.log('bundle.js.LICENSE.txt:', license.split('\n').find((l) => l.includes('Lodash')).trim()); console.log('bundle.js size:', (new Blob([bundle]).size / 1000).toFixed(1), 'KB'); })

steps.actionLabel: Fetch bundle.js and its license file
steps.actionLabelZh: 获取 bundle.js 和它的许可文件
expectConsole: bundle.js, line 1: /*! For license information please see bundle.js.LICENSE.txt */
